desc:
MM2 of Monsters 🎃

One of you is the Murderer. The rest just want to survive. 🔪

🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT: collect Candy, open the Pumpkin Box and get 7 spooky skins. Finish the event pass to unlock Bon, The Locust and the exclusive Chroma Devil Monochrome!

👹 Play as 7 creatures, each with its own power: Verity, Clark, Bon, The Locust, Golden Freddy, Tinky Tank and Monochrome.

⚡ Survivor abilities: Sprint, Ghost (turn invisible), Shield (stun the killer) and X-Ray (see everyone through walls).

👻 Died? Come back as a ghost and hunt Soul Candy.

👍 LIKE GOAL: every like unlocks rewards for EVERYONE, up to the exclusive Joyity skin!

💎 Open crates for skins from Common to Mythic, plus Unique rainbow skins, and trade them with friends.

🎁 Free case on your first visit, a free chest for joining our group, daily rewards, daily missions and diamonds every level up.

⚙️ Volume settings and Low Quality mode for any device.

Can you survive... or will you be the one hunting?
